blocks.text: Charts present data visually so that patterns are easy to see. The right kind of chart depends on the data and the question.

blocks.caption: Choosing a chart (from this section)
rows: showing how a dependent variable changes with an independent variable
showing the variability behind each mean
plant heights in three light conditions

blocks.title: Every chart needs
blocks.text: A clear title, labelled axes with units, a sensible scale, and a legend when colours or symbols need explaining.

blocks.prompt: Which chart would you use to show the percentage of a forest's trees belonging to each species?
blocks.explanation: A pie chart, because it shows the parts of a whole (all the trees).

items: Bar: compare categories; pie: parts of a whole; line: trends with an independent variable; error bars: variability.
